2026_02_SEA_ARI.headline: Seattle’s defense greets Arizona’s new home identity
2026_02_SEA_ARI.paragraph1: Arizona opens its home schedule against Seattle with Mike LaFleur getting his first regular-season game at State Farm Stadium as the Cardinals’ head coach. Arizona’s schedule release specifically frames the matchup around how LaFleur’s offense will attack a strong Seahawks defense, while Seattle’s schedule preview notes the recent road success it has enjoyed in this division matchup. The Cardinals need early-down answers that keep the playbook open; the Seahawks want to force Arizona into the passing situations their defense can anticipate.
2026_02_SEA_ARI.model_rationale: Seattle’s defensive structure against Arizona’s early-down offense determines whether the Seahawks can dictate passing situations or the Cardinals can keep Mike LaFleur’s menu open.
